newsitem.title: USA: American General names Devlin CEO.
newsitem.headline: American General names Devlin CEO.

text.p: American General Corp said on Thursday it appointed its president, Robert Devlin, to the additional post of chief executive. He will also become chairman next year.
Under the plan announced last year, the current CEO and chairman Harold Hook will retain his chairmanship until the 1997 annual shareholders meeting.
American General also elected James D'Agostino as a director, and a successor to Devlin as president from the 1997 shareholders meeting.
American General's businesses inclue retirement annuities, consumer loans and life insurance.
